The '''Mk 2e/S medium blaster cannon''' was a type of [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]].<ref name="MBC">''[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles Companion]]''</ref> [[Kav Lepkin]], leader of the [[Krayt Draggers]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]], mounted a Mk 2e/S medium blaster cannon on his [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]].<ref name="Bazaar">{{WEGCite|story=A Bazaar Encounter|book=Imperial Entanglements (Star Wars Miniatures Battles)}}</ref>
